note: Paraguay: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90, 60 or 30 days; Indonesia, Oman, Qatar and Vietnam take a visa on arrival for 30 days, Thailand for 15; everyone else applies (online, completed at a Paraguayan mission) for a visa. Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Dirección Nacional de Migraciones' own table of visa-waiver agreements (its page as Common Crawl captured it on 10 September 2026): it gives every visa-free passport and length but the Mercosur states' (no length), and corrected Wikipedia's copy, read before, on Mongolia (30 days, Ley 7206 of 17 November 2023, not 90). It shows Indonesia, Oman, Qatar, Vietnam and Thailand as needing a visa; their visa on arrival is on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' page, which refused this client, and stands on Wikipedia's copy.
